recovery.interpretation: Additional restart segment; no continuous latency comparison. Terminal results and UNKNOWN calls are preserved, never resubmitted.

runtimeProvenance.interpretation: Observed per-request latency only. Collection segments, downtime and changing service conditions do not establish continuous or causal latency comparisons.

limitations: Scheduled warm/mixed labels do not establish cache hits; raw cache status is authoritative.
Row error determines execution failure; task status is reported separately and does not invalidate successful checkpoint rows.
Missing rows remain pending; failed rows remain all-answer denominators; unavailable latency and tokens remain unavailable.
Ledger includes indexing separately identified by task kind and retries; incomplete ledger total is null.
Repeated rows and modes are correlated within forty base questions; no automatic tuning or default change.
